name: Godrej Properties Ltd.
business_summary: Godrej Group's listed real-estate developer; asset-light model (JDA, development management, outright land) across Mumbai, NCR, Bengaluru, Pune, Hyderabad, Kolkata and others. FY27 bookings targeted at a record Rs 41,500 cr (+22%) per Pirojsha Godrej (Fortune India 2026-10-25), with Rs 32,000 cr of launches planned in H2 FY27. Q2 FY27 PAT fell 62% to Rs 154 cr on lumpy revenue recognition though collections were a record; Rs 70 cr one-off from a Gurugram settlement hit sentiment in September. Market cap Rs 54,386 cr, P/E 39.8.

revenue_mix.segment: Residential real estate (bookings-led, reported on completion)
revenue_mix.geography: Mumbai MMR, NCR, Bengaluru, Pune, Hyderabad (model estimate of split)

exposures.mechanism: Pure-play resi developer (>90% of value; asset-light JDA/DM model, top-3 by bookings). +10% market volume -> GPL bookings +10% (pipeline-driven, 8-10 cities) -> revenue/EBITDA +10% with ~25% project margin and operating leverage 1.3x -> EBITDA +13%; EV/MCap ~1.35 (net debt plus customer advances), persistence 0.5 => ~+6. Anarock: top-7 city sales +3% y/y only in Jul-Sep 2026.

evidence.note: Anarock via Economic Times 2026-09-28: Jul-Sep 2026 housing sales +3% y/y to just over 1 lakh units across top 7 cities
